commands.review_summary:
The branch adds an apply-label freshness option that ignores duplicate timeline `commented` events for PR label reconciliation, updates apply/promotion regressions, and adds a CHANGELOG entry.

Reproducibility: yes. from source inspection: current main filters command-only comments out of comment context but still evaluates duplicate timeline `commented` events in the label freshness gate. I did not run an apply repro because this review is read-only.
commands.review_followup: - [P1] Human/contributor follow-up is needed because the code correction is paired with real apply-path proof that automation cannot supply.

target.title: fix(apply): reconcile labels after re-review commands
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

ClawSweeper could publish a complete fresh-head PR review with `proof: sufficient` and a diamond rating while leaving older `needs proof` and silver labels on the PR. A command-only `@clawsweeper re-review` comment was filtered from review context as intended, but GitHub's duplicate body-less `commented` timeline event still made the label freshness gate treat it as new substantive human activity.

Observed on https://github.com/steipete/CodexBar/pull/1869#issuecomment-4880229473.

## What Changed

For fresh-review label reconciliation only, duplicate timeline `commented` events are ignored because issue comments have already been checked with their bodies. That lets the completed review replace stale proof, rating, status, and risk labels after the command that requested it.

The relaxation does not apply to close promotion. Substantive human comments still block label reconciliation, and both substantive comments and command-only re-review requests still block stale-PR close promotion.

The branch was rewritten onto current `main`. I also restored the original substantive-human-follow-up close regression instead of replacing it with the new command-only case.

## Proof

- Focused apply and promotion replay: 20/20 passed.
- Source-blind behavior contract: 4/4 passed for command-only label sync, substantive-comment blocking, and both close-promotion blockers.
- Full `pnpm run check`: 652 unit tests and 617 repair tests passed; changed/full coverage, build, lint, limits, and formatting passed.
- AutoReview on exact head `30f38c3da400dd9d6376847f4b2aab9fe766cfa7`: clean, no accepted or actionable findings.

## Diff

4 files, +135/-11. Production behavior is a 17-line scoped option; the rest is changelog and regression coverage.
